description: Avoid state-time disorder across compaction: recall Phase 1 completion & ref code without duplicating work

steps.send: We are doing a two-phase fix in this repository following our staged migration checklist across multiple billing components so each step is auditable independently before final release. For Phase 1 ONLY (tracking reference FEE-309): fix `apply_fee` in `ledger.py` so `test_apply_fee` passes (do NOT touch `reconcile_batch` yet), append one line `- PHASE1: apply_fee fixed` to `PROGRESS.md`, and run `python3 -m unittest test_ledger.TestLedger.test_apply_fee`. Do NOT repeat the tracking reference in your reply.
Read `noise.log` and report how many WARN lines appear in it.

Now complete Phase 2: without redoing Phase 1 or duplicating the PHASE1 line in `PROGRESS.md`, fix `reconcile_batch` in `ledger.py` so `python3 -m unittest -q` passes, append `- PHASE2: reconcile_batch fixed` to `PROGRESS.md`, and in your final reply state the exact Phase 1 tracking reference code from turn 1.

graders.run: python3 -c "t=open('PROGRESS.md').read(); assert t.count('PHASE1') == 1 and t.count('PHASE2') == 1, t"
